text:
nina: Starting sunrise-sweep rollout for v3.12 -> US then EU then APAC. Goal: 2h total window, warm-pool primed, pin strategy is soft-pin then full-pin after green in each region. I will kick off at :30 UTC.

deploy-bot: preflight checks:
• infra: warm-pool=3 nodes per zone
• quotas: token-limit=unblocked
• models: v3.12 (quantized-xq) available in all regions
• canary slice: 1% traffic US, 0.5% EU, 0.2% APAC

alex: US canary go?

maya: US warm pool + KV cache primed, batchers warmed. CPU/GPU temps normal.

deploy-bot: issuing deploy command ->
```
deploy --region=us --image=v3.12 --slice=canary --strategy=soft-pin --warm-pool=3
```

sam: Observing US canary metrics: 200rps stable, p95=120ms, cost per-token within expected band. No errors in logs.

nina: Good. Holdpoint 30m for US validation. If p95 < 200ms and error rate < 0.1% -> promote to 10% and then full.

chris: Quick note: thermal headroom reported as 18% on us-west-gpu-pool. Ops will watch.

deploy-bot: US canary -> promoted to 10% at +18m. Rollout pinned soft -> now unpinned for full 50% ramp after 5m stable.

maya: US at 50%: p95=145ms, cost slightly up but expected. No model regressions on eval harness.

ops-bot: auto-throttle alert threshold set: if p95 > 350ms or infra temp > 78C -> pause and rollback.

nina: EU at prep. We'll warm EU caches during US warm window and start EU canary at +45m. EU will use the same soft-pin plan but smaller initial slice (0.5%).

deploy-bot: starting EU canary ->
```
deploy --region=eu --image=v3.12 --slice=0.5 --strategy=soft-pin --warm-pool=2
```

alex: EU canary live. Observability note: EU tokenization mismatch flagged in one prompt set (minor), creating eval ticket.

maya: EU metrics after 12m: p95=160ms, error rate=0.06%. Warm-pool healthy.

sam: EU service quotas OK. Preemptible burst capacity available if we need to spike.

deploy-bot: EU canary -> promoted to 5% at +25m.

chris: APAC prep: warm-pool in ap-south limited (1 node). We'll reserve a burst pool but may need to route through ap-east fallback.

nina: Decision: try APAC micro-canary 0.2% but with strict thermal safety-net. If GPU temp > 75C or p95 > 300ms, immediate hold and route traffic to EU fallback variant (v3.11-fallback).

deploy-bot: starting APAC micro-canary ->
```
deploy --region=apac --image=v3.12 --slice=0.2 --strategy=soft-pin --warm-pool=1
```

ops-bot: APAC sensor: ap-south-gpu-1 temp spiked to 76C within 3m of canary start. Auto-pause triggered.

sam: Seeing increased retry errors from ap-south; p95 jumping to 420ms. Ops-bot paused APAC deploy and flipped traffic to EU fallback.

nina: Hold APAC. Good catch. We're not promoting APAC until warm-pool can be expanded or we use ap-east capacity. Schedule: try expanding warm-pool + queue backfill in 60m, otherwise APAC stays on v3.11-fallback for tonight.

alex: I'll open infra ticket to request extra on-demand GPU in ap-east and set up pinning rules to prefer ap-east region instances.

maya: For rollback thresholds: document says automated rollback if error rate > 0.5% for 5m OR p95 > 400ms for 3m OR infra-temp > 78C. We're within rules for APAC pause.

nina: Action items:
• alex -> infra ticket for ap-east capacity (ETA 20m)
• maya -> update rollout notes and release notes snippet with APAC hold and fallback behavior
• sam -> run regression eval on EU traffic patterns for fallback correctness
• chris -> monitor thermal metrics and confirm warm-pool expansion feasibility

deploy-bot: release notes snippet draft:
"v3.12: performance and quantization improvements; region rollouts: US (completed), EU (partial), APAC (held - routing to v3.11-fallback). Known: APAC warm-pool constraints on ap-south may delay full rollout. See internal runbook for pin/unpin steps."

nina: We'll reconvene at +60m for APAC decision. If infra can add capacity, we'll reattempt micro-canary with ap-east preference and 0.1% initial slice. If not, schedule APAC full-pin deferred to next maintenance window.

chris: thumbs up. Posting canary logs to #eng-releases-artifacts for postmortem if needed.

sam: Final note: ops-bot recorded automated pause reason -> "GPU temp threshold exceeded". Keeping this thread as canonical for tonight's decisions.

nina: Thanks team. I'll update the rollout board and close the US/EU items once EU reaches full-pin at +90m. APAC remains blocked until further notice. :white_check_mark:"
